title: MIT-Educated Brothers Could Spend Decades in Prison for $25 Million Ethereum Scheme
summary: Manhattan court has opened the trial of two brothers accused of a $25M ethereum exploit; prosecutors have alleged fraud completed in 12 seconds, while the defense has argued the exploit was legal. The defense has sought to exclude Google search-history evidence; each faces up to 20 years per count.
